title: ID0393443-DC/Si-D/QA[170000162] - Tesla Cybertruck
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Tesla Cybertruck aborted session
Root cause:
EV requesting stop but a new session is created. Also the NowVol and NowCur doesn't drop and causes FEC_STOP_AFTER_STOP_TIMER error
Solution:
the car is requesting the session to be stopped.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Expired
Ecog Ticket:
SASW-2304
Note from L3:
Ticket can be closed.

From our side there is nothing else to be done. If you agree we will proceed to close this ticket.
